findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1, not 0. Existing callers who don't pass `min` now get a floor of 1 second on every wait.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)` or any config whose computed wait is below 1s. Line 273 clamps the result up to `self.min`=1, so waits become 1s instead of the configured sub-second values. This silently changes behavior for existing users, and a default of 0 would preserve the previous behavior.
